subject: Custodian handoff & evidence integration questions
messages:
From: Covenant GRC <integrations@covenantgrc.com>

Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Custodian handoff — integration & evidence questions

Hi Kimberly / Karthik,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Before we start mapping API endpoints and SFTP handoffs, our integration engineering team had a few clarifying questions about custody semantics so we can produce a clean evidence export that meets your SOC2 reviewers: 

1) Custody model: when Covenant pulls artifacts for a customer, do you want us to mark artifacts as “exported” (read-only copy) or to transfer ownership (move/delete from our store)?

2) Timestamps: do you require both artifact creation_time and collection_time in the CSV export? If so, what time zone do you prefer (UTC vs customer local)?

3) Redaction policy: we saw notes about PII redaction on the kickoff doc — do you want Covenant to pre-redact artifacts or deliver raw and let Redwood run redaction hooks?

4) Delivery endpoint: preferred options are (a) S3 with VPC endpoint, (b) SFTP over managed host, or (c) direct secure API push. Any constraints on your side?

We attached a sample evidence schema (covenant_evidence_schema_v1.csv) to show the fields we can provide. Quick ask: could you confirm expected field names for "custodian_id" and "access_path" so we align?

Goal: have an agreed schema and delivery mechanism by EOD Friday so Redrock Security (our pen test partner) can run a dry transfer next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a short call if easier.

Best,
Maya Shah
Integrations Lead, Covenant GRC
[Attachment: covenant_evidence_schema_v1.csv (text/csv)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Covenant GRC <integrations@covenantgrc.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custodian handoff — integration & evidence questions

Maya,

Thanks — this is helpful. Answers below, plus a couple of internal constraints to note.

1) Custody model: we prefer you provide an exported, read-only copy (do not delete from your store). Redwood will keep the canonical copy. Mark the artifact with exported=true and include an immutable export_id.

2) Timestamps: please include both creation_time (when the artifact was generated) and collection_time (when Covenant pulled it). Use UTC in ISO-8601 (e.g., 2026-06-21T18:03:00Z).

3) Redaction policy: deliver raw artifacts. Redwood will run our redaction pipeline so we can apply consistent rules across customers. If an artifact is pre-redacted, flag redaction_level and redactor_id in the CSV.

4) Delivery endpoint: S3 with VPC endpoint is our preference — it simplifies auditing and lifecycle policies. If S3 is not feasible, SFTP is acceptable but requires allowlisting of our egress IPs (I included the list in the attached checklist).

Field names: use "custodian_id" and "artifact_path" for the S3 key. For ACLs include "access_level" (enum: internal/customer/public).

I've attached our custodian handoff checklist (redwood_custodian-checklist-v2.xlsx) with the IP allowlist and minimal IAM policy we need for the S3 role. Two asks:
- Can Covenant confirm you can add export_id and exported=true on each row?
- Can you confirm slot for a dry-run next Wednesday (2026-06-30) morning PST? Redrock will be on the call.

If helpful, we can do a 30-min tech sync Wednesday 6/23.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_custodian-checklist-v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Covenant GRC <integrations@covenantgrc.com>

Cc: Redrock Security <redrock@pentests.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custodian handoff — integration & evidence questions

Kimberly,

Thanks for the clear answers — that all works for our team. Quick confirmations and notes: 

- export_id: we can populate export_id (UUID v4) and exported=true.
- timestamps: will use UTC ISO-8601 fields creation_time and collection_time.
- redaction: we'll send raw artifacts and set redaction_level, redactor_id if anything pre-redacted.
- delivery: S3 with VPC endpoint is fine. We need the IAM role ARN you want us to assume, and the VPC endpoint id for the bucket. If you can't share ARNs in email, please add them to the Drive folder link.

Redrock (cc'd) confirmed availability for a dry transfer on 2026-06-30 09:00-10:30 PST — they will run a scripted pull and validate checksums and permissions.

We uploaded a test CSV to our staging S3 today to exercise export_id and timestamps — path: s3://covenant-staging/evidence/test-export-20260622.csv. We'll coordinate credentials/role exchange via the Drive folder and DocuSign for the Data Processing Addendum.

Next steps:
- Covenant: prepare test CSV with export_id + timestamps and share link (today).
- Redwood: drop the IAM role ARN + VPC endpoint details into the Drive folder (or flag if we need to instead set up a short-term SFTP).
- Both: confirm dry-run on 2026-06-30.

If any of these need an in-person tech call, we can do the 30-min sync Wednesday 6/23 you proposed.

Best,
Maya Shah
Integrations Lead, Covenant GRC
